ModMetaData.name: Puppet Bio-Regeneration Fix
ModMetaData.author: ErtzFiend
ModMetaData.description:
Keeps Vanilla Psycasts Expanded - Puppeteer's puppet (VPEP_Puppet) and puppet master (VPEP_Puppeteer) hediffs from being "healed" away by a biosculpter bioregeneration cycle.
Both hediffs sit on the brain. When the brain is a restorable part (for example with BattIePatch: Enhanced Bioregeneration), the cycle cures them like an injury. That breaks the puppet link, and a removed puppet hediff gives abasia and a psychic coma.
Scope: only those two exact defNames, only on the pod occupant, and only while a bioregeneration cycle is completing. Wounds, scars, missing parts and other conditions still heal normally. Medic cycles and removal outside the cycle are unchanged.
Built and tested for RimWorld 1.7 (1.7.5005 rev1082).
